programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
高朋滿座#75粵
programme.desc: 朋上班途中遇上一代廚神刀哥突出現向朋說教，原來有「廚魔」之稱的莊天武將會來港，更下戰書指名要挑戰朋廚藝。信心十足的朋竟不將挑戰放於心，繼續日常生活。朋巧遇一位老人，他於朋面前弄了一鍋茶葉蛋後從容離去。

programme.title: 尚食#15粵普
programme.desc: 子衿畫的輞川圖落入月華之手，月華以瓜果菜蔬將輞川圖景再現，巧奪天工，卻因不合時宜和觸犯忌諱而落敗，子衿和紫萍則以一道二十四節氣餛飩，贏得皇后讚賞。遊園之日，瞻基品食時嘗出子衿做的菜式，表現出不高興。

programme.title: 阿爺廚房粵
programme.desc: 本地稻田已買少見少，鼎爺、阿譚下田體驗割禾、打穀等步驟。鼎爺用雞殼、陳皮煲煮香滑粥底，奉上荔灣家鄉美食「艇仔粥」。除了基本的水魷魚、豬皮外，加入鮮蝦、豬柳等食材令味道再「升呢」！主持們及後深入腐乳工場，見識傳統天然發酵腐乳的製作工序。二人還會分別用腐乳撈飯、塗多士，原來都喜歡加糖來中和鹹味。不同部位的排骨各有口感，鼎爺選用嫩滑的一字排，炮製香脆的「腐乳炸排骨」。豬肉本身含有油分，為何還要用油醃製？

programme.title: 才駿Hashtag 瑞銀認股證牛熊證粵
流行都市粵
programme.desc: 香港正面臨人口急速老化的挑戰，安老服務尤為重要。安老服務協會代表到來，述說行業正面對照顧者人手短缺、少數害群之馬影響形象等問題。長者入住院舍後或難以適應，院舍如何協助？大王、菲比這回隨鄧達智品嚐中菜，「招牌片皮鵝」鴨皮酥脆，並帶有甘香的鵝油；阿拉斯加蟹分別用牛油焗、雞油蒸，一蟹吃出兩種滋味；用藤椒碎蒸海上鮮，以麻辣味帶出魚香。「睇餸食飯」環節，許美德師傅示範一道「潮州椒醬肉」，香口惹味！

programme.title: 醫度講粵
programme.desc: 別以為只有肥胖人士才會有脂肪肝出現！研究顯示，全球大約每四名成人就有一人有非酒精脂肪肝。《醫度講》這集有內分泌及糖尿專科胡依諾醫生、註冊中醫師何慧欣與李澄琳營養師，以及非常注重肝臟健康的藝人黃庭鋒，探討與解構「脂肪肝」的成因和治療方法，也會向觀眾推薦預防食療。

programme.title: 才駿Hashtag 瑞銀認股證牛熊證粵
五味人生#7粵
programme.desc: 雙春認為永禎所用的手法旁門左道，卻無法阻止。勝天向永禎訴苦，說監察修橋補路的工程令他苦悶不已，永禎教勝天應把金鳳追到手後才拋棄她以作報復。勝天的保鏢之科到洋貨店找金鳳，更代勝天邀約她翌日飯聚……雙春偕九妹拜訪飛揚，希望飛揚能收九妹為徒卻遭他婉拒。飛揚遇若嵐得知她欲到溪間捉魚，於是拋下俗務陪伴師妹。所長指喜相逢以不道德手法經營突然查封酒樓。雙春因而指摘永禎，但關老太反而支持他；雙春忍不住大發脾氣……

programme.title: 偶像星願7 Third BEAT!粵日
programme.desc: 來到MOP當日，成海對獎項仍然有偏見，但聽過IDOLiSH7和TRIGGER的賽前訪問後開始動搖。兩隊男團先後在台上演唱新歌，精彩表演迷倒現場觀眾和網民，大家開始踴躍投票，最後由TRIGGER以些微差距壓過IDOLiSH7贏得大獎。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 「廠長話」遊戲中，「團長」Tiffany姐姐代替蚌蚌公主發號施令。四位零食小兵於「熱身賽」已多次犯錯，在沒有「廠長話」指令下做動作。踏入正式的「淘汰賽」時，大家能否集中精神，聽清楚指令並避免再失誤？執行神奇地壺任務其間，兩隊均成功利用撞擊技巧，「收集」到由蚌蚌公主指定的食材，獲得零食秘笈作獎勵。挑戰「溶化之橋」時，有小兵僅差數步就完成運送任務。雖然掉落雪糕球，他仍可保持歡容，樂觀心態值得讚賞。

programme.title: 天才高球少女粵日
programme.desc: 阿圓和蜻蛉一起打高爾夫球，前者採用專一極致打法，實行以不變應萬變，令五十嵐為之感嘆。阿圓問蜻蛉有什麼夢想，蜻蛉說她要永遠留在島上，阿圓表示懷疑，反問她是否只是自欺欺人。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 馬百良六寶靈芝呈獻:最強生命線粵
programme.desc: 香港有三到四成的人都有代謝性脂肪肝，也就是說每十個人裏面有四個就有。在糖尿病患者中這個比例更高達七八成。糖尿病和肥胖症患者都是高發人群。代謝性脂肪肝早期通常無明顯症狀，若出現症狀，可能包括疲勞、右上腹不適或脹氣、食慾不振。隨著病情惡化，可能出現更嚴重的症狀，如黃疸（皮膚和眼白變黃）、水腫、體重減輕，甚至可能演變成肝硬化或肝癌。患者都是透過驗血發現肝酵素偏高，須配合影像檢查如超聲波或電腦掃描檢查才能確診。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
滙豐保險呈獻：準備退休有乜計粵
programme.desc: 退休是一段嶄新的人生篇章，值得細心規劃與期待。若可提前安排好財務、健康、生活的方向，便能於退休後真正享受自在和安穩。王祖藍、李亞男這對演藝圈的模範夫婦，引領觀眾從不同方面切入，認知退休所需準備，務求可在財務與生活規劃上更周全，得以輕鬆迎接屬於自己的人生新階段。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 觀眾報料指荃灣某商場，有男子以膊頭撞向多名年輕女士，疑似借機「抽水」……再有駕駛者懷疑遇上撞車碰瓷騙案，對方以事故導致喪失工作能力為由，索償逾二百萬。繼續追蹤離職女保安報工傷事件，節目組發現她在街頭擺賣，並身手矯健地搬運貨物。記者嘗試就工傷一事向女保安求證；大律師指若誇大病況申報工傷謀取利益，或可能觸犯詐騙罪。新節目《試真D》首播，江美儀率領周嘉洛、朱敏瀚等四位男拍檔一同欣賞，並暢談深刻拍攝點滴。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2785粵
programme.desc: 吳旺達與某國確立合作關係，城安在此事上立大功，獲該國官員讚賞。城安認為自己是幹大事的「大人」，樹仁等卻提出不少事例，指他仍表現得像個「細路」，過於依賴長輩，難以自行解決問題。城安欲反駁眾人卻不果，尚善似乎對他感失望，遂自行離去。為了證明自己是「大人」，城安嘗試為尚善處理不少「大事」，卻未獲她讚賞。其後，城安發現尚善之前離席似乎另有原因，為了證明自己能夠照顧尚善，他作出不少嘗試，詎料……

programme.title: 康業信貸快遞物業貸款呈獻：正義女神#12粵PG
programme.desc: 惠知因壓力太大，身體出現毛病，在醫院偶然見到睿燊的身影，其後獲睿燊相告其不為人知的過去……「危險駕駛致他人死亡案」中，被告張智斌是睿燊曾幫助的少年犯，多年來睿燊幫他自力更生，但智斌與從前的社團夥伴再次牽扯上，甚至涉嫌合謀將撞車殺人偽裝成車禍。只有睿燊堅信智斌真心改過，鍥而不捨尋找證據……惠知審理一宗「蓄意傷人案」，被告指被少女何嘉茵偷錢包；惠知思量細節，懷疑嘉茵是「兼職女友」，並與被告認識……

programme.title: 大生意人#7粵普PG
programme.desc: 平原提出用闖王寶藏做交易，天貴答應。平原把天貴及其手下帶到藏寶的地方，眾人看到寶藏狂喜，平原趁機觸發密室機關，把他們關在裡面。皇帝駕崩，新帝大赦天下，平原終於能回家了，一路上卻看見茶園的茶苗被燒焦…

programme.title: 試真D粵
programme.desc: 富麗堂皇、古色古香的唐朝主題餐廳，讓人恍如一秒穿越古代！縱打卡一流，但薑蔥蟹、蒜蓉蝦等熱食「凍上」，美儀姐忍不住向店方控訴。「宮女」獻舞娛賓，嘉洛一時興起亂入表演，旁若無人……坤哥亦近距離求證「群魔亂舞」的網上評語。來到排長龍糖水檔，坐在路邊享用夠風味！豆腐花、芝麻糊、涼粉等甜品統統「平靚正」，附近坑渠卻飄來異味，可會有所扣分？下一站試試惠州傳統手工美食「釀春」、「阿嫲叫」，三人品嚐後竟同感疑惑？

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
及時雨信貸呈獻：談判專家#5粵
programme.desc: 訓練期間，可人與楊光同組，可人怒責楊光提示模糊，令自己表現失準。楊光與可人的表現不如理想，被簡潔當眾宣讀為成績最差的兩位學員。可人偶然知楊光與孝武是兄弟，感詫異。國棟偶然發現家聰向簡潔隱瞞行蹤，細問下家聰坦承有婚外情。國棟見楊光向可人獻殷勤，誤會楊光為追女仔才投考談判專家。楊光因犯錯被國棟當眾奚落，更斥為垃圾，激發其鬥心，決要向國棟展示實力。家聰與文靜同因伴侶工作忙碌，被冷落多時，早已發展婚外情。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 觀眾報料指荃灣某商場，有男子以膊頭撞向多名年輕女士，疑似借機「抽水」……再有駕駛者懷疑遇上撞車碰瓷騙案，對方以事故導致喪失工作能力為由，索償逾二百萬。繼續追蹤離職女保安報工傷事件，節目組發現她在街頭擺賣，並身手矯健地搬運貨物。記者嘗試就工傷一事向女保安求證；大律師指若誇大病況申報工傷謀取利益，或可能觸犯詐騙罪。新節目《試真D》首播，江美儀率領周嘉洛、朱敏瀚等四位男拍檔一同欣賞，並暢談深刻拍攝點滴。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 香港正面臨人口急速老化的挑戰，安老服務尤為重要。安老服務協會代表到來，述說行業正面對照顧者人手短缺、少數害群之馬影響形象等問題。長者入住院舍後或難以適應，院舍如何協助？大王、菲比這回隨鄧達智品嚐中菜，「招牌片皮鵝」鴨皮酥脆，並帶有甘香的鵝油；阿拉斯加蟹分別用牛油焗、雞油蒸，一蟹吃出兩種滋味；用藤椒碎蒸海上鮮，以麻辣味帶出魚香。「睇餸食飯」環節，許美德師傅示範一道「潮州椒醬肉」，香口惹味！

programme.title: 醫度講粵
programme.desc: 別以為只有肥胖人士才會有脂肪肝出現！研究顯示，全球大約每四名成人就有一人有非酒精脂肪肝。《醫度講》這集有內分泌及糖尿專科胡依諾醫生、註冊中醫師何慧欣與李澄琳營養師，以及非常注重肝臟健康的藝人黃庭鋒，探討與解構「脂肪肝」的成因和治療方法，也會向觀眾推薦預防食療。

programme.title: 五味人生#7粵
programme.desc: 雙春認為永禎所用的手法旁門左道，卻無法阻止。勝天向永禎訴苦，說監察修橋補路的工程令他苦悶不已，永禎教勝天應把金鳳追到手後才拋棄她以作報復。勝天的保鏢之科到洋貨店找金鳳，更代勝天邀約她翌日飯聚……雙春偕九妹拜訪飛揚，希望飛揚能收九妹為徒卻遭他婉拒。飛揚遇若嵐得知她欲到溪間捉魚，於是拋下俗務陪伴師妹。所長指喜相逢以不道德手法經營突然查封酒樓。雙春因而指摘永禎，但關老太反而支持他；雙春忍不住大發脾氣……

programme.title: 高朋滿座#75粵
programme.desc: 朋上班途中遇上一代廚神刀哥突出現向朋說教，原來有「廚魔」之稱的莊天武將會來港，更下戰書指名要挑戰朋廚藝。信心十足的朋竟不將挑戰放於心，繼續日常生活。朋巧遇一位老人，他於朋面前弄了一鍋茶葉蛋後從容離去。

programme.title: 尚食#15粵普
programme.desc: 子衿畫的輞川圖落入月華之手，月華以瓜果菜蔬將輞川圖景再現，巧奪天工，卻因不合時宜和觸犯忌諱而落敗，子衿和紫萍則以一道二十四節氣餛飩，贏得皇后讚賞。遊園之日，瞻基品食時嘗出子衿做的菜式，表現出不高興。

programme.title: 我係小廚神粵
programme.desc: Janice、Summer晉級總決賽，攜同助手炮製包括頭盤或湯、主菜及甜品的套餐，上演終極對決，兩人能發揮應有的廚藝本領嗎？評判團有主持林盛斌、黃翠如、六位專業評判及肥媽，共同見證「小廚神」的誕生！

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
高朋滿座#76粵
programme.desc: 朋發現老人所弄茶葉蛋比他好，欲改變比賽形式卻失敗，於是問計家人，眾建議朋向他拜師，可惜老人拒絕。簽約作實當日，「廚魔」莊天武現身。當朋著急時，赫然發現廚魔的真正身分，更了解這場比試只會自招其辱而已。

programme.title: 尚食#16粵普PG
programme.desc: 皇上最寵愛的幼子衛王在用膳時突然昏迷，胡尚食指孟尚食呈上的鹿角菜有毒，皇上下令把涉事庖廚一律拿下。子衿為救孟尚食和紫萍甘願承受杖責。子衿向皇后示警，善祥診出衛王並非中毒，瞻基決定帶衛王到自己宮中養病。

programme.title: 交易現場粵 及 鼎植口腔呈獻：齒中守護你粵
阿爺廚房粵
programme.desc: 本地豬受到嚴格規管，用甚麼飼料可令豬隻增強免疫力，味道亦與別不同？有優質豬，鼎爺亦不吝嗇功夫及時間，巧製一道「水晶豬手凍」來討好阿譚。豬皮要做出外表晶瑩剔透，豬皮膠汁宜蒸不宜煮。鼎爺繼續大顯刀法功架，將木耳、蝦仁、帶子、竹筍、滑豆腐切得盡量幼細，帶來可解油膩的上海菜「酸辣文思豆腐海皇羹」，酸辣開胃。燜煮五花腩是滋味菜餚，鼎爺還於滷水料中加入「四物」食療元素，令香氣更出，尤其適合女士滋補。

programme.title: 滙豐保險呈獻 :準備退休有乜計粵
programme.desc: 退休是一段嶄新的人生篇章，值得細心規劃與期待。若可提前安排好財務、健康、生活的方向，便能於退休後真正享受自在和安穩。王祖藍、李亞男這對演藝圈的模範夫婦，引領觀眾從不同方面切入，認知退休所需準備，務求可在財務與生活規劃上更周全，得以輕鬆迎接屬於自己的人生新階段。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 「小腸氣」學名為疝氣，是指肚內器官經缺口向外凸出，不一定只關小腸事！外科醫生解釋男士患小腸氣較女士常見的先天結構原因，可怎樣透過手術作治療？脊醫指出，膝關節的骨與骨之間內藏二氧化碳，如壓力增加或勞損會釋出二氧化碳而發出「卡卡聲」；若附隨痛楚，則有可能患上「髕骨股骨疼痛綜合症」？坐在椅子上及準備橡筋帶，隨脊醫做強化肌肉的預防運動！「睇餸食飯」環節，譚詠儀示範「宮保雞丁」做法之餘，也分享餸菜背後故事。

programme.title: 醫度講粵
programme.desc: 肥胖不只影響外表，更會引起各種併發症，而世界衛生組織已將肥胖列為疾病。內分泌及糖尿專科胡依諾醫生這集聯同註冊中醫師何慧欣、李澄琳營養師，為大家解構「肥胖症」，同時推薦減肥食療給觀眾。本集更有藝人何依婷分享心理學與肥胖的關係，想知道更多關於這個病症的資訊？切勿錯過這集《醫度講》！

programme.title: 五味人生#8粵PG
programme.desc: 永禎與利是妹從關老太口中聽到雙春的不幸遭遇，利是妹指永禎玩得過火了。月圓之夜，若嵐狂性大發用利剪襲擊雙春…… 酒樓生意門堪羅雀，卻突然有大批客人湧進，原來是永禎使出了「假客人」計畫。勝天發現金鳳竟在這裡義務擔任英文老師，不禁對她另眼相看。義學雖開辦成功，但不少學生因要謀生而沒法上學；勝天提議可實施「上學包午飯」方針。雙春向若嵐說出她的病況，令她大受打擊；為了助若嵐回復記憶，飛揚竟決定下廚煮菜。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 霹靂舞近年被列入奧運、亞運比賽項目，而這集「Kids’ Notes」嘉賓曾子驊有達廿年霹靂舞經驗，更試過代表港隊參賽！霹靂舞動作基本上可分為搖滾步、排腿、定點、大地板，B-Boy曾子驊即席示範四個元素。小朋友想學跳舞，可如何入手？他細說霹靂舞評分準則，還提到有為小舞者而設的賽事。曾子驊憶述曾負傷出賽，投入舞蹈下暫時忘卻傷痛，並取得佳績，足見他對霹靂舞的熱愛。談到多地選手特點，本港舞者有何突出之處？

programme.title: 天才高球少女粵日
programme.desc: 颱風吹襲，阿圓也來到開發中心暫避，蜻蛉跟她學習如何練習揮桿。五十嵐找到一張球場路線圖，上面記載了不為人知的4號洞至6號洞，讓蜻蛉挑戰過4號洞後，五十嵐決定帶她去見設計者垢多先生。

programme.title: 世界觀粵 及 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵

programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2786粵
programme.desc: Ceci與瑞輝、力蓮洽談合作，偕同「新歡」現身，瑞輝發現對方竟是昔日於夜場的舊同事。舊同事帶瑞輝回夜場聚舊，瑞輝發現場面冷清，人事全非。為要留住客人，舊同事以瑞輝的「黑材料」威逼他東山復出。其後，家聰偶然發現瑞輝向別的女人獻殷勤，行為極為過火，遂向力蓮示警。力蓮起初並不相信，後來卻察覺瑞輝確有不妥，於是前往舊同事工作的夜場暗中查探，最終有意想不到的發現……

programme.title: 康業信貸快遞物業貸款呈獻：正義女神#13粵PG
programme.desc: 思義在車房巧遇知行，父子因昔日郊野雙屍案再生爭執，思義始終懷疑他參與行劫，甚至涉及姦殺，二人心結難解。惠知原本審理的「蓄意傷人案」，其後牽扯出「少女援交平台案」，最終揭發更深的黑幕。知行駕電單車遇意外，車尾箱竟散出百萬現金！剛好附近海味店遭爆竊，知行脫不了嫌疑，因而被捕。惟媒體重提雙屍案，質疑知行會獲法官父親包庇，令思義憤而放棄保釋他。「海味店盜竊案」由惠知審理，知行認罪卻拒絕交代剩餘贓款下落……

programme.title: 大生意人#8粵普PG

programme.title: 醫度講粵

programme.title: 高朋滿座#76粵

programme.desc: 家聰車禍受傷，文靜慰問。文靜暗中送禮物給家聰慶祝週年紀念。楊光與可人順利過關，正式成為談判專家。家全喜歡可人，可人不知所措，遂找楊光假裝情侶，家全大受打擊，再萌自殺念頭，可人與楊光開解家全，令家全不再以自殺來獲取別人關心。簡潔知家聰於餐廳訂了情侶晚餐，悉心打扮，但家聰謊稱要工作未能相陪。及後簡潔發現家聰衫袋內有該餐廳收據，簡潔開始懷疑。家聰與簡潔往油站入油，職員認錯簡潔為另一女子，簡潔的疑心更大。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 《流行都市》為觀眾介紹時令產品、健康養生、健體運動、護膚化妝、時尚服飾、嬰幼兒護理、育兒知識、城中美食、飼養寵物等潮流資訊，內容包羅萬有！主持們親身體驗、示範或測試之外，還會邀請嘉賓帶來相關專業知識。烹飪環節方面，多位手勢了得的廚藝專家輪流登場，示範簡單美味的健康美食、家常小菜，替大家解決煮食煩惱。

programme.title: 醫度講粵
programme.desc: 你睡覺時，會「打鼻鼾」嗎？你晚上有否因呼吸不順暢而影響睡眠質素？你可能患上「睡眠窒息症」！這集有受到疑似此症影響的藝人朋友何廣沛到來，請教內分泌及糖尿料胡依諾醫生、註冊中醫師何慧欣與李澄琳營養師有關睡眠窒息症的成因及治療方法，並即場面診！

programme.title: 五味人生#9粵
programme.desc: 飛揚完成五色炒飯，若嵐果然憶起了不少昔日事情。雙春把看見飛揚煮菜的技巧全都告訴九妹，九妹試煮，眾人大讚好味。若嵐胡亂用方法欲替自己治病險象橫生；雙春只得再拜託飛揚煮菜卻被推辭。飛揚的太太婉君努力下，飛揚終答應替若嵐煮菜。勝天向父親提出辦慈善舞會，替義學籌經費。鎮長為選出誰主理舞會膳食，讓喜相逢與吉慶樓作廚藝比試；飛揚更答應九妹能在比賽中勝出，便收他為徒。雙春靈機一觸，想到在山中及海邊獵取野味作菜。

programme.title: 高朋滿座#77粵
programme.desc: 大會安排二人進行廚藝比賽前哨戰，朋無奈答應，但天武的廚藝實技高一籌。天武表明早已厭倦比賽生活，求朋一起放棄決戰。慶看出他們在意比賽，勸服二人比拼。二人出盡法寶煮出最得意的菜色，惜二人參賽只是宣傳技倆。

programme.title: 尚食#17粵普
programme.desc: 衛王浪費食物，子衿希望他學會珍惜食物，衛王聽不進耳，還想抓子衿出氣；蘇月華在一帆的幫助下到御前侍奉；她投皇帝所好製膳，使皇帝食用過多葷腥導致流鼻血，郭貴妃知道蘇月華為了上位不擇手段，想廢掉她的雙手…

programme.title: Do姐有問題粵PG
programme.desc: 清邁有炸雞師傅每天將手放進沸油中，他受了甚麼刺激？有何方法令一顆朱古力升價百倍？盧覓雪、阮兆祥為分甘同味，企圖自製打和賽果，可惜在祥仔旁邊的是被形容為「沒帶腦上班」的C君，祥仔最終能否嚐到黑松露美食？

programme.title: Do姐有問題粵PG
programme.desc: 單立文偕妻子胡蓓蔚擔任嘉賓，不停發放笑彈，引得Do姐對他們的相處方式大感好奇。秘魯青蛙汁有何功效？東京一間沒有廚師的食店，食物從何而來？台灣麵店老闆為何炮製分量足夠十人食用的「大碗麵」？

programme.title: 搗蛋拉茶鋪
programme.desc: 熱愛拉茶的老闆，和自信滿滿的服務生狗狗，在飄著香氣的拉茶鋪裡享受著愜意的時光。然而一切平靜，都被一隻搗蛋的猴子破壞了！為了趕走猴子，狗狗與猴子的戰鬥即將展開！

programme.desc: 韓國教育電視台EBS製作的寓教於樂卡通，可輕鬆認識大自然的樣貌。神秘事件在森林裡發生，栗子莫名消失，昆蟲朋友離奇失蹤，皮特、巴巴、茉莉對這些事件展開調查。帶著偵探精神一起度過難關，在繁忙的調查過程中，共同學習、共同成長，創造學習樂趣。

programme.title: 人偶之家
programme.desc: 【丈夫經商失敗！崔明吉調包財閥孫女只為讓女兒入豪門】琴英淑是一位愛女心切的母親，性格溫厚，在丈夫生意失敗時，她也從不抱怨，自願到殷會長的家裡擔任管家。女兒京慧出生時便被診斷出心臟疾病，當時家境也很難提供好的醫療資源。在一場車禍中，她意外的將女兒京慧，與財閥孫女世妍互相掉包身分，本該是千金小姐的世妍也因此變為平凡人，在百貨擔任精品店職員，而京慧更是直接躍升為財團富三代，然而某一天世妍得知真相，發現原本屬於她的富貴人生全被京慧奪走，憤怒之下她改名換姓，決定拿回屬於她的一切。

programme.title: 優雅的朋友們
programme.desc: 【夫婦的世界「升級版」！初戀女神現身揭開五人幫隱藏面具】一場離奇猝死與密室謀殺，撕裂大學「五人幫」維持二十年的體面假象。死黨萬植離世，失蹤多年的初戀海淑突然現身，喚醒男人們被西裝掩蓋的慾望與罪惡。模範人夫宮哲察覺妻子靜海疑似出軌，威脅她的教練卻隨即身亡，監視器與證物一夜消失。嫉妒的丈夫、被逼到絕境的妻子、病態迷戀的死黨，誰在說謊？當祕密層層揭開，每個人都是嫌疑犯，誰才是最終的殺人兇手？

programme.title: 暖陽之下
programme.desc: 【溫馨陸劇/二寶＆事業該選誰？ 都市夫妻的兩難抉擇！】宋思凝懷著夢想隻身來到北京，經過多年打拼終於成為公司的人力總監，與創意公司總經理李俊龍成為夫妻，並育有一兒，日子過得幸福美滿。但在婚育觀上，兩人的想法有極大的分歧，經常為了女兒的教育問題爭吵，李俊龍希望能與思凝生育二寶，然而正值事業上升期的思凝，面臨自我實現與家庭的兩難衝突，在大都會生活的兩人又該如何抉擇呢？

programme.title: 白夜童話
programme.desc: 【《紳士與小姐》朴荷娜演技狂飆復仇拋夫棄子生母】從小遭母親拋棄，加上父親早逝，白夜與哥哥相依為命，性格堅強好勝的她總對哥哥百般依賴，也因嫉妒哥哥與大嫂的好感情，生活中常常刁難懷孕的大嫂，搞得哥哥十分頭疼。某天哥哥與生母連絡上，面對母親拒絕相認，哥哥內心大受打擊，一晃神就因交通意外不幸離世，得知此事的白夜便將所有憤怒轉向母親，展開一系列的報復計畫。

programme.title: 吹吧微風
programme.desc: 【千億遺產考驗林智妍淪落魄千金竟遭林秀香假冒身分】一場跨越南北的失散命運，意外揭開千億財產背後的血緣騙局。脫北女孩微風重返南韓，與多年不見的初戀律師長高重逢，卻被捲入豪門爭產與身世之謎。冒名孫女設局奪產，謊言層層堆疊，親情逐漸崩裂；長高的母親強勢介入，以門第與前途逼迫兒子放棄真愛。當真相一一曝光，有人為貪念付出慘痛代價，有人失去一切。被犧牲的愛情，是否還能在命運翻轉後，迎來真正的團圓？

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 先熱情地打掃吧
programme.desc: 【《紅天機》金裕貞搭《玫瑰公寓》尹鈞相，上演元氣女與潔癖男的浪漫喜劇！！】立志消滅所有細菌，把清潔視為人類崇高使命，拒絕與他人肌膚接觸，無法忍受灰塵，經營清潔公司的潔癖執行長張善傑。遇上外表邋遢個性不拘小節的四次元少女吉五雪，畢業後的首份就業工作，努力完成員工清潔使命。極與極相遇的浪漫愛情喜劇。

programme.title: 君九齡
programme.desc: 九齡公主生性善良，喜好醫術，一場陰謀使得她失去至親，骨肉分離，容貌大變。為了查清真相報仇雪恨，九齡隱姓埋名一直蟄伏，靠著堅強的毅力和意志力，苦練技藝，不放過任何蛛絲馬跡，最終發現這場陰謀背後還有一段不為人知的皇室辛秘。知曉真相後的九齡，回到京城，在兇手不斷的騷擾和攻擊中建立了醫館九齡堂，濟世救人，受人尊崇。與此同時，朱瓚與清貴公子寧雲釗、前夫陸雲旗、方家獨子方承宇，身份各異、關係複雜的四人，陷入了以九齡為核心的感情漩渦。誰才是九齡的真命天子？

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 兩個人的小森林
programme.desc: 虞書欣鎖定張彬彬，小太陽系女孩專治萬年冰山。戀愛正在發芽中！！】時尚美妝部落客虞美人，外表光鮮亮麗，卻始終放不下大學時期暗戀對象植物學教授莊羽。一次命運重逢，讓她決定重新展開追愛計畫。理性寡言的他，卻對這位熟悉又陌生的女孩逐漸敞開心扉。從城市學校到鄉村社會，從誤解到理解，在一片綠意中，共築屬於彼此的「小森林」，慢慢治癒、慢慢相愛。

programme.title: 先熱情地打掃吧
programme.desc: 【《紅天機》金裕貞搭《玫瑰公寓》尹鈞相，上演元氣女與潔癖男的浪漫喜劇！！】立志消滅所有細菌，把清潔視為人類崇高使命，拒絕與他人肌膚接觸，無法忍受灰塵，經營清潔公司的潔癖執行長張善傑。遇上外表邋遢個性不拘小節的四次元少女吉五雪，畢業後的首份就業工作，努力完成員工清潔使命。極與極相遇的浪漫愛情喜劇。

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 君九齡
programme.desc: 九齡公主生性善良，喜好醫術，一場陰謀使得她失去至親，骨肉分離，容貌大變。為了查清真相報仇雪恨，九齡隱姓埋名一直蟄伏，靠著堅強的毅力和意志力，苦練技藝，不放過任何蛛絲馬跡，最終發現這場陰謀背後還有一段不為人知的皇室辛秘。知曉真相後的九齡，回到京城，在兇手不斷的騷擾和攻擊中建立了醫館九齡堂，濟世救人，受人尊崇。與此同時，朱瓚與清貴公子寧雲釗、前夫陸雲旗、方家獨子方承宇，身份各異、關係複雜的四人，陷入了以九齡為核心的感情漩渦。誰才是九齡的真命天子？

programme.title: 搗蛋拉茶鋪
programme.desc: 熱愛拉茶的老闆，和自信滿滿的服務生狗狗，在飄著香氣的拉茶鋪裡享受著愜意的時光。然而一切平靜，都被一隻搗蛋的猴子破壞了！為了趕走猴子，狗狗與猴子的戰鬥即將展開！

programme.title: 機械城足球隊
programme.desc: 每天放學後，機器人艾力都會和朋友們在森林公園的小足球場一起踢足球。有人內向，有人天才，有人愛搞怪，各式各樣的人集結成一支很棒的隊伍，展開一段熱血青春的足球故事。

programme.title: 森林偵探
programme.desc: 韓國教育電視台EBS製作的寓教於樂卡通，可輕鬆認識大自然的樣貌。神秘事件在森林裡發生，栗子莫名消失，昆蟲朋友離奇失蹤，皮特、巴巴、茉莉對這些事件展開調查。帶著偵探精神一起度過難關，在繁忙的調查過程中，共同學習、共同成長，創造學習樂趣。

programme.title: 人偶之家
programme.desc: 【丈夫經商失敗！崔明吉調包財閥孫女只為讓女兒入豪門】琴英淑是一位愛女心切的母親，性格溫厚，在丈夫生意失敗時，她也從不抱怨，自願到殷會長的家裡擔任管家。女兒京慧出生時便被診斷出心臟疾病，當時家境也很難提供好的醫療資源。在一場車禍中，她意外的將女兒京慧，與財閥孫女世妍互相掉包身分，本該是千金小姐的世妍也因此變為平凡人，在百貨擔任精品店職員，而京慧更是直接躍升為財團富三代，然而某一天世妍得知真相，發現原本屬於她的富貴人生全被京慧奪走，憤怒之下她改名換姓，決定拿回屬於她的一切。

programme.title: 優雅的朋友們
programme.desc: 【夫婦的世界「升級版」！初戀女神現身揭開五人幫隱藏面具】一場離奇猝死與密室謀殺，撕裂大學「五人幫」維持二十年的體面假象。死黨萬植離世，失蹤多年的初戀海淑突然現身，喚醒男人們被西裝掩蓋的慾望與罪惡。模範人夫宮哲察覺妻子靜海疑似出軌，威脅她的教練卻隨即身亡，監視器與證物一夜消失。嫉妒的丈夫、被逼到絕境的妻子、病態迷戀的死黨，誰在說謊？當祕密層層揭開，每個人都是嫌疑犯，誰才是最終的殺人兇手？

programme.title: 暖陽之下
programme.desc: 【溫馨陸劇/二寶＆事業該選誰？ 都市夫妻的兩難抉擇！】宋思凝懷著夢想隻身來到北京，經過多年打拼終於成為公司的人力總監，與創意公司總經理李俊龍成為夫妻，並育有一兒，日子過得幸福美滿。但在婚育觀上，兩人的想法有極大的分歧，經常為了女兒的教育問題爭吵，李俊龍希望能與思凝生育二寶，然而正值事業上升期的思凝，面臨自我實現與家庭的兩難衝突，在大都會生活的兩人又該如何抉擇呢？

programme.title: 白夜童話
programme.desc: 【《紳士與小姐》朴荷娜演技狂飆復仇拋夫棄子生母】從小遭母親拋棄，加上父親早逝，白夜與哥哥相依為命，性格堅強好勝的她總對哥哥百般依賴，也因嫉妒哥哥與大嫂的好感情，生活中常常刁難懷孕的大嫂，搞得哥哥十分頭疼。某天哥哥與生母連絡上，面對母親拒絕相認，哥哥內心大受打擊，一晃神就因交通意外不幸離世，得知此事的白夜便將所有憤怒轉向母親，展開一系列的報復計畫。

programme.title: 吹吧微風
programme.desc: 【千億遺產考驗林智妍淪落魄千金竟遭林秀香假冒身分】一場跨越南北的失散命運，意外揭開千億財產背後的血緣騙局。脫北女孩微風重返南韓，與多年不見的初戀律師長高重逢，卻被捲入豪門爭產與身世之謎。冒名孫女設局奪產，謊言層層堆疊，親情逐漸崩裂；長高的母親強勢介入，以門第與前途逼迫兒子放棄真愛。當真相一一曝光，有人為貪念付出慘痛代價，有人失去一切。被犧牲的愛情，是否還能在命運翻轉後，迎來真正的團圓？

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 先熱情地打掃吧
programme.desc: 【《紅天機》金裕貞搭《玫瑰公寓》尹鈞相，上演元氣女與潔癖男的浪漫喜劇！！】立志消滅所有細菌，把清潔視為人類崇高使命，拒絕與他人肌膚接觸，無法忍受灰塵，經營清潔公司的潔癖執行長張善傑。遇上外表邋遢個性不拘小節的四次元少女吉五雪，畢業後的首份就業工作，努力完成員工清潔使命。極與極相遇的浪漫愛情喜劇。

programme.title: 君九齡
programme.desc: 九齡公主生性善良，喜好醫術，一場陰謀使得她失去至親，骨肉分離，容貌大變。為了查清真相報仇雪恨，九齡隱姓埋名一直蟄伏，靠著堅強的毅力和意志力，苦練技藝，不放過任何蛛絲馬跡，最終發現這場陰謀背後還有一段不為人知的皇室辛秘。知曉真相後的九齡，回到京城，在兇手不斷的騷擾和攻擊中建立了醫館九齡堂，濟世救人，受人尊崇。與此同時，朱瓚與清貴公子寧雲釗、前夫陸雲旗、方家獨子方承宇，身份各異、關係複雜的四人，陷入了以九齡為核心的感情漩渦。誰才是九齡的真命天子？

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 兩個人的小森林
programme.desc: 虞書欣鎖定張彬彬，小太陽系女孩專治萬年冰山。戀愛正在發芽中！！】時尚美妝部落客虞美人，外表光鮮亮麗，卻始終放不下大學時期暗戀對象植物學教授莊羽。一次命運重逢，讓她決定重新展開追愛計畫。理性寡言的他，卻對這位熟悉又陌生的女孩逐漸敞開心扉。從城市學校到鄉村社會，從誤解到理解，在一片綠意中，共築屬於彼此的「小森林」，慢慢治癒、慢慢相愛。

programme.title: 先熱情地打掃吧
programme.desc: 【《紅天機》金裕貞搭《玫瑰公寓》尹鈞相，上演元氣女與潔癖男的浪漫喜劇！！】立志消滅所有細菌，把清潔視為人類崇高使命，拒絕與他人肌膚接觸，無法忍受灰塵，經營清潔公司的潔癖執行長張善傑。遇上外表邋遢個性不拘小節的四次元少女吉五雪，畢業後的首份就業工作，努力完成員工清潔使命。極與極相遇的浪漫愛情喜劇。

programme.title: Binti

programme.title: The Little Comrade

programme.title: Messy goes to OKIDO (S3) - Memory Games
programme.desc: Messy goes to Okido and learns how to 'jog' his memory,

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops (S1) - Dewey Dragon
programme.desc: Preston is in costume as everyone's favourite character, Dewey Dragon, but he isn't ready for how demanding Dewey's fans are. Mojo and Bo need to help him escape the crowd.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Dragon
programme.desc: When Bluey needs some assistance drawing a dragon for a story she is working on, she asks her dad, Bandit, for help.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Show and Tell
programme.desc: Bluey wants to know why Dad's always bossing her around.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S5) - The Metal Detector Badge
programme.desc: Roly needs a wee, but the door is locked and Duggee has mislaid the key. Not to worry, Duggee has his metal detector.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S5) - The Diary Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels find a dusty, old book behind a cupboard... it's Duggee's diary from when he was a teenager! The Squirrels are keen to write diaries of their own.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - Hey Quacky!
programme.desc: Worm and Ladybird wonder what's going on at Squirrel Club. There's a gorilla playing drums, some helpful ducks, a hot frog, four goats and a hospital run by chicken doctors.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - Frog Song
programme.desc: It's fun on the counting train until Naughty Monkey starts to drive! Ethel makes a shape, Frog drops beats with a ribbit song, and Enid turns into anime to chase after a mouse.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S3) - The Salmon Run, Alaska
programme.desc: Alaska's a cool place to watch the salmon run, but Glitch opens a 'fishy taxi service' to help the salmon avoid tricky waterfalls and greedy bears. What could possibly go wrong?

programme.title: Bluey (S1) - Mums and Dads
programme.desc: When Indy and Rusty play Mums and Dads, they can't agree on who should go to work, so they part company. Indy has a hard time finding a babysitter, while Bluey makes Rusty her baby.

programme.title: Bluey (S2) - Handstand
programme.desc: At a party, Bingo is desperate to show off her handstand skills, while Nanna can't find a way to make herself useful. They're both feeling a bit lost, until they find each other.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Curry Quest
programme.desc: Bingo and Dad must brave a swooping magpie protecting its nest, when they go on a curry swap to Mackenzie's house through the park.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Magic
programme.desc: Bluey teaches Bingo how to use magic so she can make Mum play with her, but she forgets to explain the most important rule: never use magic for cheekiness.

programme.title: Andy's Aquatic Adventures (S1) - Andy and the Amazon Cichlid
programme.desc: Andy takes to the skies in his safari-mobile, jetting off to the Amazon River in Brazil in search of a rare cichlid fish. Along the way, he has a run in with a hungry stingray.

programme.title: Playtime Towers (S1) - Hoop
programme.desc: Bella and Lift visit the Cloud Kitchen, where Patch needs some help from the Playtimers to make hoopy owl bagels. It's time for a tasty adventure!

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S2) - The Camping Badge
programme.desc: Duggee and the squirrels are going camping and they hear a scary noise outside the tent!

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S2) - The Medicine Badge
programme.desc: Duggee's not very well, he's lost his voice. The Squirrels want to make him feel better. Duggee tries to tell them that he needs some water but the Squirrels don't quite understand, so they ask all the other animals for advice. Does anyone have the answer?

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S2) - The Pizza Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels help Duggee try out his new outdoor pizza oven. Duggee makes the bases, then the Squirrels each put on all the toppings they like best. Some of their combinations are... interesting!

programme.title: Go Jetters (S2) - Go Jet Academy: Compass Navigators
programme.desc: Can Kyan and Foz use new compass skills to navigate their way out of an academy maze?

programme.title: Go Jetters (S2) - Nomads, Mongolia
programme.desc: Glitch offends some nomads in Mongolia, so it's down to the Go Jetters to take the reins.

programme.title: Thomas & Friends (S23) - Diesel Glows Away
programme.desc: When notorious Diesel hides from the other engines, his plans backfire and he gets a surprise on Sodor.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck (S2) - Origami Overload
programme.desc: John has a problem with the origami flamingos he has made and needs Sarah and Duck's help.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck (S2) - The Big Sleepover
programme.desc: The little girl and her feathery friend have a sleepover with some friends, but struggle to get to nod off.

programme.title: Stan Can (S1) - Mermaid
programme.desc: Fifi asks Stanley to help them find a Mermaid so they can take its picture for school. They explore the ocean floor in their search where they encounter lots of ocean creatures.

programme.title: Stan Can (S1) - Sophie Can Do
programme.desc: Stanley asks Sophie to help out with a few of his jobs whilst she waits for her dino costume to dry. The pair go about town fixing everyone's problems in fun and imaginative ways.

programme.title: Funny Talking Animals (S1) - I Actually Gave Santa a High Five
programme.desc: The talking animals talk about everything they love about Easter, Halloween, and Christmas!

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran (S3) - It's Time for a Dance Class
programme.desc: JoJo is excited to go dancing and to help her friend Henry at his first dance class.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Cubby
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo build a very special cubby for their stuffed toy Kimjim.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Exercise
programme.desc: Dad thinks he needs to do some exercise, but Bingo pretends to be Boss Bluey's new employee in the middle of Dad's backyard workout.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Relax
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo would rather explore their holiday hotel room than relax on the beach.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S2) - The Comedy Badge
programme.desc: The squirrels go to see what Duggee is doing but on the way Tag stumbles on some toy blocks and hurts his knee. How can they make him feel better? Happy's mum says laughter is the best medicine.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S2) - The Looking After Badge
programme.desc: Outside the clubhouse a large crowd has gathered around a hot air balloon with whisperings that someone is going on an adventure!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - Ladybird's Gameshow
programme.desc: Spot the odd one out or guess who lives here. A great memory tip from Duggee, an edition of The Agony and Eggstacy, and how to draw Enid - down to her last whisker.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S3) - Go Jetter Heroes: Polar Explorers

programme.title: Teletubbies (S1) - I Spy
programme.desc: The voice trumpet leads a game of 'I Spy' where the Teletubbies have to spot different colours - purple, green, yellow and red. What or who can they spot with those colours?

programme.title: Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung goes incognito to mix with his people and understand their needs. He encounters many strange things along the way, including being arrested and nearly beheaded. Who will save him?

programme.title: Magnificent Wanderers
programme.desc: Lin and his two friends are traveling patriots who vow to stand up against violence and fight for justice. They meet a rich young man Chu by chance one day and the four become best friends. When a foreign prince plots to possess Chu's family fortune and goes after him, Lin and friends go all out to help Chu fight against the villain.

programme.title: Princess Iron Fan
programme.desc: As Monkey and his gang make their way to the West through Fire Mountain, they ran into the evil Princess Iron Fan, Madam White Bone and her sexy sister, and have to fight their way through.

programme.title: Return of the Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: This sequel makes for more bittersweet laughs and heart-wrenching misfortune, as Ah Niu gets out of the jail to find his true love becoming the wife of an abusive husband, and his uncle further exploits his naive nature.

programme.title: King Drummer
programme.desc: A young musician Chi Chiang is hired by the manager of a popular band when the group's drummerleader Charlie, quits to join a rival group. The new drummer becomes an immediate hit, causing Charlie to be very jealous. Furthermore, the young drummer's mother is dead set against him having a music career.

programme.title: Puppy Love
programme.desc: To the tune of the Osmonds hit song, this is a story of adolescent playfulness & innocence lost. Two best friends grow up together and teasingly meet two delightfully impish boys leading to the four to flirtatiously intermingle. However, the innocence of partner swapping eventually leads to a roller-coaster bouts of misunderstood emotions.

programme.title: Death Valley
programme.desc: When Jianying discovers the Zhao clan's fortune will be left to his brother Yulong, he engineers his parents' death and sends his own son out to kill Yulong.

programme.title: When the Clouds Roll By
programme.desc: Su is a schizophrenic who refuses to believe that her pilot lover is killed in a plane crash and makes up stories to deal with things. She runs into an old classmate Lai, who is also a doctor one day, and he finds ways to treat her illness. Su slowly recovers and accepts the reality, as well as her newfound love.

programme.title: Flying Guillotine 2
programme.desc: In a time of anti-Manchu sentiment, Emperor Yong Zheng employs his ruthless Blood Hound Corps to silence any dissenters. Only one man and his signature weapon, The Flying Guillotine, stand in their way.

programme.title: Passing Flickers
programme.desc: This film is an amusing insider's look at the Hong Kong film industry and is based on Director Li Han Hsiang's popular newspaper column recounting his work at Shaw Brothers. The collection of some of his funniest and most surreal film musings of the era, filled with behind-the-scene asides, this is a must-see for any Hong Kong cinema aficionado!

programme.title: The Long Chase
programme.desc: Governor Yan is killed and his guard Fan identifies Kou as the assassin by his signature weapon, a dart. Kou is listed as a wanted man when he enters the city, but managed to escape arrest with the help of the innkeeper's daughter. At the same time, Fan is attacked by a bandit who pretends to be Kou. What are the secret plots behind these attacks?

programme.title: Disco Bumpkins
programme.desc: This musical comedy is about how a young man Fen, along with his buddy Hamburger, finds love and success in the advertising world.

programme.title: The Blood Brothers
programme.desc: The friendship of three sworn brothers, Zhang, Huang and Ma ends when Ma gives in to corruption and falls for Huang's wife, eventually leading to a bloody ending.

programme.title: The Voyage of Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung continues his incognito voyage to southern China. Accompanied by the minister and the imperial scholar, they have many amusing encounters in Yangzhou.

programme.title: The Enchantress
programme.desc: Shot on the Shaws' lot in the final years of Hong Kong's greatest studio, The Enchantress tells the story of martial artists who disappear in the night! Intrigued, wanna-be detectiveswordsman Feng Chi-wu (Mok Siu-chung) is determined to find out what is happening. But when Feng finds out that an evil vampire spirit (Wei Chiu-hua) is killing swordsmen, he's in for more than he bargains for... It's an outlandish fairy-tale and martial arts fantasy, where your fists and sword aren't nearly enough!

programme.title: The Enchantress
programme.desc: Shot on the Shaws' lot in the final years of Hong Kong's greatest studio, The Enchantress tells the story of martial artists who disappear in the night! Intrigued, wanna-be detectiveswordsman Feng Chi-wu (Mok Siu-chung) is determined to find out what is happening. But when Feng finds out that an evil vampire spirit (Wei Chiu-hua) is killing swordsmen, he's in for more than he bargains for... It's an outlandish fairy-tale and martial arts fantasy, where your fists and sword aren't nearly enough!

programme.title: Illicit Desire
programme.desc: This instant cult classic adapts three erotic and mystical tales from the Chinese classical works, with stories spanning across time from the Tang to Ming dynasties. The stories, filled with characters such as emperors, concubines, monks and fortune-tellers, intertwine in a world of adultery, lust and greed, alongside great costumes!

programme.title: Monkey Kung Fu
programme.desc: Wei Chun is a cocky young man sentenced to jail for killing a man in a fight. One day, Wei Chun picks a fight with a seemingly defenseless old man who completely thrashes him! The old man turns out to be the master of monkey style kung fu and as they become friends, he gives Wei Chun half of a medallion that would direct him to hidden secrets.

programme.title: Heroes of the East
programme.desc: A Chinese man marries a Japanese woman through an arranged marriage and manages to insult all of her Japanese martial arts family by issuing a challenge to her that is misinterpreted by the others. He must then prove how good Chinese Kung Fu really is through a series of duels with the seven Japanese martial artists who come to meet the challenge!

programme.title: Rose, Be My Love
programme.desc: Not a love triangle but a love 'rectangle', Rose, Be My Love is a romantic drama set on the eve of World War II that represents the high standards achieved by Shaw Brothers in both aspects of star power and technical polish.

programme.title: Heaven and Hell
programme.desc: When an angel, Ling, decides to help his two friends who have fallen in love to escape from Heaven, he is sent to live as a human on earth as his punishment. Reincarnated as a cab driver, he sacrifices his own life to save another ill-fated couple and lands in hell, where he has to face off against the ghosts and demons to fight his way out!

programme.title: Enchanting Shadow
programme.desc: A young scholar Ning spends the night in a creepy temple that is said to be haunted. He does not believe in the rumours, but soon meets a beautiful female ghost Nie. Nie is forced to stay in the temple to seduce young men for a powerful demon to feast on. Knowing Nie to be a kind ghost, Ning decides to help her escape from the demon's clutches.

programme.title: The Brave Archer 2
programme.desc: Knowing Guo Jing has won Huang Rong's hand in marriage using the kung fu learned from Jiu Yin manual, Ouyang Feng captures Huang and agrees to release her only if Guo can dictate the content of the manual. Will Guo give in to the threat?

programme.title: Diary of a Lady-killer
programme.desc: Tycoon Zhou is a playboy who is engaged to be married, but that did not keep him from working his charms on as many ladies as he can. He keeps a diary about his romantic escapades and soon, the women with whom he has been intimate with are being murdered one by one. Zhou becomes the number one suspect by the police but is the killer someone else?

programme.title: Clan Of The White Lotus
programme.desc: The head of White Lotus Clan, Lo, is a highly skilled martial artist who supports the Qing government and helps destroy the rebellion group. Hung from Shaolin who kills Lo's brother, is being hunted and hides in another rebel Hu's house. The clan attacks at night killing Hu and his sister, but Hung manages to get Hu's pregnant wife to safety.

programme.title: Lady General Hua Mu-Lan
programme.desc: Mulan disguises herself as a male soldier to replace her aged father in a war against the barbarians. Her courage brings her victory in battles and she was promoted to a general. When Mulan returns home with glory, the chief commander asks her to marry his daughter, forcing Mulan to reveal her true identity.

programme.title: Lady With A Sword
programme.desc: Swordswoman Feng tries to find a group of villains responsible for her eldest sister's death, but is shocked to discover that her fiance, Jin, is one of them. At the same time, Jin's mother and the two other killers are planning to kill Feng. Can Feng fight back and take her revenge?

programme.title: Forever And Ever
programme.desc: Ivy Ling Po plays a young scholar who is manipulated into marrying a nobleman's reluctant daughter. After marrying, he soon discovers the reason for her hesitation. She is stricken with a contagious disease. But, with the power of true love, their romance prevails.

programme.title: Clan Feuds
programme.desc: Tie Zhong Tang, the adopted son of the Great Banner Sect leader, is hunted by the sect's rival for the secret to its hidden treasure. To uncover the truth, he journeys to an island seeking the "Empress of the Day", only to find her dead. There, he unexpectedly meets the sect's founder, the "Emperor of the Night", who reveals that he is Tie's biological father.

programme.title: The Three Smiles
programme.desc: A talented scholar, Bo Hu, is attracted by the pretty maid, Qiu Xiang. In order to get close to her and win her love, he disguises as a servant to work in the same household. Qiu Xiang does not believe Bo Hu when he discloses his true identity to her, only falling in love with him when he reveals his talents and with his friends' help.

programme.title: The Three Smiles
programme.desc: A talented scholar, Bo Hu, is attracted by the pretty maid, Qiu Xiang. In order to get close to her and win her love, he disguises as a servant to work in the same household. Qiu Xiang does not believe Bo Hu when he discloses his true identity to her, only falling in love with him when he reveals his talents and with his friends' help.

programme.title: Invincible Enforcer
programme.desc: A young man is at the wrong place at the wrong time. As he offends a police inspector, he is thrown into jail and even when released, the police goes after him until he has no choice but to become a real criminal. Only a kind and beautiful probation officer is on his side, but can she help him?

programme.title: Return Of The Dead
programme.desc: A long-awaited horror sequel after Enchanted Shadow, this is about three asylum inmates telling their stories. In story one, a husband and wife discover they should be careful what they wish for. A naked female ghost seeks revenge from her watery grave in story two, and a dead prostitute returns as a ghost in the last tale.

programme.title: The Millionaire Chase
programme.desc: It's a fun and wild romp that mixes pleasure with pleasure. A nightclub owner, playboy Peter Chen Ho, has his ways with three sisters while gallivanting across Asia. Each one has a dangling relationship to save - ensuring a series of mishaps and comic moments.

programme.title: A Maid From Heaven
programme.desc: The seventh daughter of the Jade Emperor is banished from heaven to live a mortal life as she is very mischievous. She falls in love with a young village lad Yong, who sold himself to work for the rich so as to bury his father. The goddess sisters help Yong to pay his debt so the lovebirds can be together. Is this going to end happily-ever-after?

programme.title: Duel For Gold
programme.desc: Six swordsmen, including two sisters and their husbands, a ranger and a security man, are trying to steal a million gold taels from the Fu Lai Treasury House, not knowing that one of them is actually an undercover hero. In their quest, they have to double-cross and outwit one another...

programme.title: My Dream Boat
programme.desc: This is a story about the complicated love relationships between a group of young friends who are entangled in a web of love and emotions.

programme.title: The Rescue
programme.desc: Threatened by the Yuan who are closing in to rule the whole of China, a band of Song survivors band together to save their prime minister. This bold and fearless heroes fighting for their cause are led by international star, Lo Lieh (Glass Tears, Killer Clans) and Shi Szu (Lovers Destiny), who must fight their way out of trap after trap. But they can't escape them all, and eventually the two end up in prison... it is either death or a fight to the end!

programme.title: The Love Eterne
programme.desc: Ying Tai disguises herself as a boy to go to school and falls hopelessly in love with her classmate, Shan Bo. After Shan Bo realizes her true identity, he proposes marriage to Ying Tai. However, they are kept apart as she is engaged to another man. Knowing Shan Bo died in despair, Ying Tai is in deep sorrow and kills herself at his grave.

programme.title: Clans of Intrigue
programme.desc: Heroic outlaw Chu Liu Xiang is dining with his friend Monk Wu Hua, when Gong from the Holy Water Palace appears and accuses Chu of stealing the holy water from her Palace and using it for various murders. Chu denies, and is given a month to find the murderer or be killed by Gong. To prove his innocence, Chu decides to investigate the case...

programme.title: The Comedy of Mismatches
programme.desc: Two pairs of lovers got mismatched accidentally. The man disguises as a woman for his sister's wedding ceremony, while his lover disguises as a man to marry another woman. After the marriage mismatches are revealed, the lovers and their families are taken to court, where Prefecture Chief Qiao manages to work out a happy ending.

programme.title: The King Boxer
programme.desc: This tale of a honorable fighter's retraining in the "Iron Palm" style, that became the first international martial arts movie hit and made a continent-spanning star of Lo Lieh.

programme.title: We Love Millionaires
programme.desc: In this romantic comedy, three beautiful Hong Kong salesgirls travel to Osaka in Japan to pursue their dreams of marrying a rich man. They masquerade as high society debutantes and make their way to a posh resort to meet and woo millionaires (or fake ones!).

programme.title: Mercenaries From Hong Kong
programme.desc: Filmmaker Wong Jing produced Mercenaries From Hong Kong, his very first modern-day adventure drama. In the dramatic plot he wrote, he sends superstars Ti Lung, Chen Hui-min, Wang Lung-wei, Lo Lieh and Wang Yu on a deadly mission. The film's action sequences are all closely guided by three great kung fu choreographers, led by Tang Chia!

programme.title: Hu Bao Xun Zong - EP33

programme.title: Fight Back to School II
programme.desc: Following his demotion, officer Sing resigns from the police force and goes undercover at an international school to privately investigate a terrorist plot. There, he discovers bumbling detective Tat posing as a teacher. Forced into an alliance, they team up to confront the heavily armed criminals behind the plot in a chaotic showdown.

programme.title: The Monkey is Back
programme.desc: The savior of the people, Stone Monkey, has given hope to a desperate little girl which he promises to realize. Years later, Stone Monkey is defeated in a battle with the three-eyed God of War, causing him to lose his power and falls into the mortal world. Can he fulfill his promise to the girl and stop the God of Wood from destroying earth?

programme.title: Endless Love
programme.desc: A young girl encounters a novelist in a bar and quickly falls in love with him. However, it turns out she has fallen into a trap set up by the novelist and his ex-girlfriend who is a ghost with a disfigured face. The journey of revenge and ultimate terror has just begun!

programme.title: Drunken Master
programme.desc: After provoking the son of a local tyrant, young Wong Fei Hung is sent by his father to train under Drunken Master Beggar So. When his father uncovers the tyrant's plot to sell mines to the Japanese, he becomes a target for assassination. To save his father and stop the sale, Fei Hung must forge his own "Drunken Fist" style to defeat the killers.

programme.title: The Case of Disappearances
programme.desc: In Misty Village, the adopted son Wen Jie is haunted by a recurring nightmare. He delves into a series of disappearance cases in the village to seek his true identity. As more villagers die mysteriously, belief in the curse of Emperor Jing Lung intensifies. Wen Jie teams up with the security chief to unveil the conspiracy and protect the villagers.

programme.title: Ip Man
programme.desc: Wing Chun grandmaster Ip Man's matchless fighting skills are revered all over China. Set during the Sino-Japanese War, Ip Man is forced to leave his home and work to support his family. With only his martial arts skills, he reluctantly agrees to train others in the art of Wing Chun for self-defense.

programme.title: Perfect Girls
programme.desc: Chi will inherit his dying grandfather's fortune with one condition - he has to be married in a month, otherwise the money goes to his uncle, Robert. Chi falls in love with Siu Siu, but Robert intends to stop them by sending Moraine to seduce Chi. When Moraine decides to marry Chi for money, Robert stops her and reveals their plot.

programme.title: Nezha
programme.desc: A former top team racing driver wants to prove himself in a race but accidentally hurts his teammate Lily, leading to the team's downfall. When an inexperienced virtual car racing champion joins the team and unexpectedly shines in a real-life race, can the three drivers team up to regain glory for their team?

programme.title: Cop Shop Babes
programme.desc: Island East Police Station headed by Madam Lui is known for its "Cop Shop Babes" as all the officers there are female. Two police officers, Beer and Satay, apply for an internal transfer to this station in order to approach the girls. It is at this time that the police receives a bomb threat - can they resolve the case?

programme.title: Shark Busters
programme.desc: During the financial crisis, a vast majority of Hong Kong people experience difficulties in repaying debts. During this time, loan sharks use ruthless ways to force debtors to repay their loans and it is up to Officer Lee and his underground team to hunt down the head of this illegal organization.

programme.title: Love on Delivery
programme.desc: A delivery boy Yin wants to impress his dream girl Li, so he enrols in a martial arts course to learn strange moves. Being timid, Yin saves Li while wearing a Garfield mask but the credit is stolen by Karate Master, Liu. To prove himself and win Li back, Yin defeats Liu in the ring with his unique martial arts move "Invincible Wind and Fire Spin".

programme.title: Behind the Yellow Line
programme.desc: A fresh graduate, Paul, strikes up an acquaintance with a pretty young girl, Monica, on the metro. Monica is involved in a love affair with a married man while Paul is also pursued by a rich girl. When Paul vows his true love for Monica, she suggests playing hide-and-seek with him in the metro to decide if they are fated to be together.

programme.title: Iceman the Time Traveler
programme.desc: In this sequel, the four imperial guards are defrosted and reanimated in modern Hong Kong. Driven by a single goal to obtain the Golden Wheel of Time and right the wrongs of the past, Ying embarks on a perilous quest, unaware that every step draws him deeper into a deadly trap.

programme.title: How to Pick Girls Up !
programme.desc: Xin, a helpless loser in love, calls in to a radio show hosted by DJ Tsang to ask desperately for help. A self-proclaimed love expert, Tsang takes it upon himself to make sure Xin meets girls and leads him on a series of absurd excursions into the wild and dangerous world of modern love.

programme.title: Out of the Dark
programme.desc: An old lady died after mysteriously falling off a building and her ghost appears to haunt the place. This freaked out the security guards, who invite ghostbuster Leo and his female assistant to help. In the process, Leo finds out that the old lady was killed by her son and daughter in law. To rest her soul, Leo promises to bring the couple to justice.

programme.title: Loving You
programme.desc: A bad-tempered, womanizing cop who always neglects his wife is shot in the head as he hunts down a drug dealer. Though he miraculously survives, he must depend on his wife to nurse him back to health. During the recovery, he begins to re-evaluate his life and repair the damages of his broken marriage.

programme.title: Loving You
programme.desc: A bad-tempered, womanizing cop who always neglects his wife is shot in the head as he hunts down a drug dealer. Though he miraculously survives, he must depend on his wife to nurse him back to health. During the recovery, he begins to re-evaluate his life and repair the damages of his broken marriage.

programme.title: Jealousy
programme.desc: Model Min is admitted to a hospital, but mysteriously falls to her death at night. Rumour has it that the hospital is haunted. Subsequently, Min's photographer begins receiving eerie phone calls, the writer loses consciousness in a bizarre car accident, and her friend mysteriously disappears...

programme.title: Royal Tramp II
programme.desc: The leader of Dragon clan, Long Er, helps General Wu to overthrow Emperor Kang Xi. However, Long Er is betrayed by General Wu and is rescued by Xiao Bao. As a result, she bestows her virginity and martial arts power to Xiao Bao to fight against Wu. At the same time, Xiao Bao fortuitously unveils the hidden treasures from "The Sutra of 42 Chapters".

programme.title: Sex Beyond The Grave
programme.desc: During World War II, a singer was raped and killed by Master Tao during her escape, with all her valuables stolen as well. Since then, the Tao's house became haunted. Years later, Master Tao's descendant sells the house to a young couple to pay off a massive gambling debt, but the couple soon discover that it is haunted by the vengeful spirit...

programme.title: Blind War
programme.desc: Former SWAT captain Dong Gu suffers traumatic visual loss during a failed mission for which he is forced to take responsibility. He manages to get over and adapt to the situation with his daughter's company, until his nemesis appears and puts his daughter in danger. Despite being blind, Dong Gu must fight to save his daughter.

programme.title: Iceman
programme.desc: Falsely accused of murder, Ming Dynasty Imperial Guard Ying is pursued by his three sworn brothers until a fierce battle leaves all four entombed in ice. Four hundred years later, they awaken in modern Hong Kong, where they must reignite their ancient feud in a world they can barely recognize.

programme.title: Hong Kong Playboys
programme.desc: Sheng is a rich playboy who lives a carefree and fun life with the ladies, until his mother decides that he should get married. Up against other lady killers in his quest to find Miss Right, Sheng must decide what he wants.

programme.title: Face to Face
programme.desc: Tamotsu dies in a skiing accident and his roommate Yoshio marries his wife as well as inherits his entire fortune. At Tamotsu's funeral, Yoshio sees a badly disfigured old man and that is only the beginning of an evil downfall for him...

programme.title: The Comeback
programme.desc: Uncle Hua is a retired agent who owns an antique shop on an old street. When the old street is forcibly demolished by the local Green Dragon Gang one day, Uncle Hua's hidden identity is accidentally revealed, and he is pursued by a mysterious organization headed by Ah Jie. A fatal duel has just begun!

programme.title: Fight Back to School III
programme.desc: When millionaire Wong is found murdered in a hotel room, Sing, who bears a striking resemblance to the victim, goes undercover as the deceased to investigate the case. With Wong's marriage already on the rocks, his wife becomes the prime suspect. However, Sing soon uncovers that Wong's close friend is suspicious as well...

programme.title: The Grey Men
programme.desc: Hong Kong police officer Ah Shan goes undercover in prison to gain the trust of criminal Tian, in order to seek evidence against his gang. After their release from jail, Shan helps Tian rise within the gang and become the new boss. However, just as Shan successfully cracks down on the gang, he uncovers a shocking secret about Tian...

programme.title: The Fate of Reunion
programme.desc: Thousands of years ago, Green Snake gained enlightenment under the guidance of Dao Qing and gradually falls for him. However, her devotion to Dao Qing caused him to reincarnate and go through the pains of death. Since then, she sets out to search for the many reincarnations of Dao Qing over hundreds of years to help him reverse the situation...

programme.title: Teenage Dreamers
programme.desc: Ting Ting is a student in an all-girl high school. She tries out for the school's stage production of Romeo and Juliet with an all-boy school and promptly falls for the lead, Jackson. While Ting Ting is swept away by the excitement of her first love, Jackson turns out to be more of a player than a partner.

programme.title: Ip Man 2
programme.desc: After the Sino-Japanese war, Wing Chun grandmaster Ip Man and his family experience hardship in their hometown and eventually moved to Hong Kong for a new life. He wants to open a martial arts school in Hong Kong, but first he must pass and win the challenges put forth by the local martial arts grandmasters.

programme.title: Girl with the Diamond Slipper
programme.desc: An aspiring TV actress gets into hot water when a stolen diamond is hidden in the shoes she bought for a party.

programme.title: Girl with the Diamond Slipper
programme.desc: An aspiring TV actress gets into hot water when a stolen diamond is hidden in the shoes she bought for a party.

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh
programme.desc: When a young housewife's debt-ridden, philandering husband leaves her with a mountain of tax debts, a security guard is hired by the tax authority to guard the assets, but he starts falling for her instead.

programme.title: Iron Kung Fu Fist
programme.desc: Liang Kun is a skilled martial arts master who left the martial arts world to protect his lover. However, his disappearance leads to her tragic death and as Liang Kun finds a way to survive in the martial arts world, he fights back to avenge his lover's death with the help of a beggar gang leader.

programme.title: Seeding Of A Ghost
programme.desc: It's an erotic gore-fest starring Kao Fei who seeks vengeance against his wife's rapists and killers by soliciting the help of a demented magician. In return, he endures copulating dead bodies as his enemies perish in blood spurting and body exploding glory. It's one of Hong Kong goriest films ever made.

programme.title: Maoshan Heavenly Master
programme.desc: Prisoner Chi flees away under Master Zhang's custody, causing the latter to be expelled from his clan. On his way to find Chi, Master Zhang arrives at a place where many people vanish for no reason. He soon discovers that it is Chi who captures them in his training to become a serpent demon. The war between human and demon has just begun!

programme.title: Fate Jealous Greed
programme.desc: The film consists of three short horror stories: a man tries to survive after he received a haunted mail predicting his death; while a man mourns the death of his beloved wife, she becomes a ghost and tries to communicate with him; three brothers clash over the care options of their elderly mother during dinner, leading to a terrifying murder.

programme.title: Royal Tramp
programme.desc: Wei Xiao Bao is sent by a revolutionary group to be a spy in the imperial palace and find "The Sutra of 42 Chapters". Xiao Bao soon befriends Emperor Kang Xi but must carry out his mission at the same time, so he is caught between two camps.

programme.title: Open the Coffin
programme.desc: Ghost Hand and his tomb raiders resurface in Jiang City to seek gold in ancient tombs after a 3-year absence. They released an evil spirit from a coffin and all four died at home eventually. Poison and pinholes in the corpses become the sole clue for police investigation. A tomb raid now unfolds as a perplexing and mysterious case.

programme.title: Maybe It's Love
programme.desc: A girl Marble witnesses a murder case and reports it to the police. After much investigation, the police can only sort out the complicated relationships between a rich merchant's mistress, a postman, a shop owner and his wife, but find no clue as to who the murderer is. Therefore, Marble decides to carry out her own investigation...

programme.title: Detrimental
programme.desc: You Ji Ren is a blind man who works at a factory in an outlying island. When the factory is cut off from the outside world by a hurricane one day, a monster appears and turns whoever sees it into black shadows. As You cannot see the monster, he is able to help other coworkers leave safely and fight to kill the monster!

programme.title: Forbidden City Cop
programme.desc: A wild and hilariously anachronistic tale of an imperial guard of the Forbidden City who has no martial arts abilities. When the emperor is abducted, he saved the day with his unusual hobby: tinkering with futuristic inventions!

programme.title: Mother VS Mother
programme.desc: Guan De Xing fell in love with Li Xiao Yun when he was young, but was opposed by his mother and had to marry Zhou Shen Yu. Since then, Li holds a grudge against Zhou. Unfortunately, the son of Guan and Zhou falls in love with Li's daughter, and as the two mothers meet, they start brawling again!

programme.title: Unbeatable
programme.desc: Former world champion boxer Fai meets fiery young fighter Qi in Macau. As he mentors Qi for an upcoming MMA tournament, Fai rekindles his passion for fighting, life, and the people he cares about.

programme.title: Mr Vampire
programme.desc: Taoist priest Kou is assigned to re-bury a rich man, in the hope that the new tomb will bring further prosperity. When the corpse turns into a vampire and wreaks havoc in the village, his disciples are also hurt by the vampire and possessed by a female ghost respectively. How can Kou save his disciples and hunt down the vampire at the same time?

programme.title: The Flying Mr. B
programme.desc: Mr. Shi, a secondary PE teacher, accidentally takes a "super pill" invented by the science teacher and gains superpower, turning into Mr. B. He uses his superpower to help the school sports team win the championship and prevent crimes. When the triad is made aware of Mr. B's superpower, they try to gain the super pill for nefarious purposes.

programme.title: The Last Tycoon
programme.desc: Gangster Chen Da Qi rises to the upper echelons of power, but finds himself torn between the love of two women, the murderous plots of the secret service, and the looming threat of war.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - The Mad Scientist
programme.desc: The Mad Scientist turns out to be an ally called Akna, who has a history with Blade's brother Alfie. And Blade learns another truth about her brother and his mission. And in the course of a skirmish with Klaus and Veruca, the weapons change hands again.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - Apok-ta-pokalypse Now Part 1
programme.desc: As the Dragon Knights prepare to battle for the weapons and control of Tikal, Mastodon attempts to teach Po how to access storm powers to use in the fight. Blade comes face to face with Klaus and Veruca.

programme.title: 3Below: Tales of Arcadia S1 - There's Something About Gwen (of Gorbon)
programme.desc: When Stuart’s larger-than-life ex-girlfriend surprises him with a visit, Aja, Steve, Vex, and Nana join them on a triple date- where issues from each of their relationships come to a head. Meanwhile, Krel, Toby, and Eli discover a new passion: Sci-Fi filmmaking.

programme.title: 3Below: Tales of Arcadia S1 - Asteroid Rage
programme.desc: With an asteroid hurdling toward Earth, threatening to destroy Arcadia Oaks, Aja and Krel must join forces with Area 49-B -- Colonel Kubritz and Tronos -- to stop it. These strange bedfellows might save the town, but this alliance comes at a cost.

programme.title: 3Below: Tales of Arcadia S1 - Lugg's Day Out
programme.desc: Krel finally gets the wormhole generator working, only for Luug to eat it! The Royals race to catch their teleporting pup before their secret alien identities are uncovered. But the chase for Luug uncovers something far worse… Morando is on Earth.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S1 - The Final Key
programme.desc: Ms. Nowhere tells the kids that the failed mission is over, but Tony isn’t ready to give up, and he’s determined to rescue Frostee. The crew goes rogue by deciding to steal the final key from Shashi and trade it for their friend.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S1 - Ignition
programme.desc: Shashi finally reveals his master plan.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S1 - The Key To The Strip
programme.desc: The kids battle Shashi in Las Vegas as Shashi tries to take down evil billionaire Cleve and use Skeleton Key to create a new world order. Frostee has a plan to get Skeleton Key offline, but it only gives Tony ten seconds to take Shashi out and save the world.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S1 - Escape from L.A.
programme.desc: Tony and his crew have been working as spy racers in LA for a while now and are itching to go international. Whey they discover a mysterious man with a strange tattoo of a formula in a smuggling ring bust, Ms. Nowhere finally agrees to let them go to Rio to investigate the tattoo and the whereabouts of one of her agents who has gone dark - Layla Gray.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S1 - That Sinking Feeling
programme.desc: Ms. Nowhere drops the kids off in Brazil and leaves to go on her own important mission, but things immediately go south for Tony and his crew. When the hauler and gear gets caught in quicksand, Tony needs to learn that a good leader knows when to accept help.

programme.title: Tinga Tinga Tales S1 - Why Hummingbird Hums
programme.desc: You see there was a time when Hummingbird didn't hum. She was called Songbird and Songbird thought she could sing like a Bird… but sadly that was not the case. All the animals tried to help Songbird improve her singing but nothing worked. What could they do?! Then Tortoise has an idea, maybe Songbird can sing without opening her beak!! Songbird agrees and hums the most beautiful hum Tinga Tinga has ever heard. From that day on Songbird was called Hummingbird. Tales from Africa.

programme.title: Tinga Tinga Tales S1 - Why Baboon Has A Bare Bottom
programme.desc: You see there was a time when Baboon didn't have a bare bottom and he was very naughty. Baboon loved to play tricks. He played tricks on Elephant. He played tricks on Ostrich. He even dared to play tricks on Lion, the King of Tinga Tinga! And then all the animals decided it was time for the tricks to stop and Baboon to get a dose of his own medicine. Tales from Africa.

programme.title: Postman Pat: Special Delivery Service S3 - Postman Pat And The Runaway Bath
programme.desc: Pat must deliver an old bath tub to Pencaster Lighthouse. But when he goes to collect it from Thompson Ground, the bath ends up rolling away into Greendale with Jess inside! When Pat catches up with the bath he finds PC Selby about to impound it for being an un-road-worthy vehicle. Pat explains it's a Special Delivery and at last gets on his way.

programme.title: Postman Pat: Special Delivery Service S3 - Postman Pat And The Loch Ness Monster
programme.desc: Mrs Goggins is on holiday, so Sarah Gilbertson is looking after her dog Bonnie. She calls in on Pat and proves she has zero control over the dog. But there is only time for Jess to roll his eyes before Pat is called out on a special delivery - it's urgent! Noddy asks PatPat to make a new snuggleball but Cloppycorn doesn't like it. It doesn't feel cuddly like his special toy. Clever Noddy asks everyone in Toyland to give the new snuggleball a big hug.

Using all his detecting skills Noddy follows the clues to the DareDale Caves where he realises that the ship on the horizon isn't Tina the Terrible's galleon at all.

They were using them as pom-poms to cheerlead Pink Ninja as she ran the Toyland Marathon Race! The Ninjas are very sorry that they upset Farmer Tom but he tells them that it's alright.

programme.desc: When some pieces from Big Ears' jigsaw puzzle go missing, Noddy investigates: where are the missing pieces? He soon realises someone must have taken them and draws up a list of suspects. Having discounted the Pirates and then the Naughticorns, Noddy is baffled. But when Pat-Pat and the Pockets invite him to share a piece of toy cake, Noddy suddenly has a breakthrough: maybe it wasn't one toy who took lots of pieces but lots of toys who each took one piece.

programme.title: Tinga Tinga Tales S1 - Why Bees Sting

The trouble was all the precious honey was disappearing and there was a honey crisis in Tinga Tinga. Something had to be done. Luckily clever old Tortoise has a cunning plan. Tales from Africa.

programme.title: Tinga Tinga Tales S1 - Why Peacock Struts
programme.desc: You see there was a time when Peacock didn't strut. He was a very proud bird and he wanted to be the best at everything. He wanted to be the best bird-brain in Tinga Tinga. He wanted to be the best flyer in Tinga Tinga and he wanted to have the biggest and the best tail in Tinga Tinga…. But as Lion so wisely points out ‘Sometimes it's not good to get everything you want!' Tales from Africa.

programme.title: Postman Pat: Special Delivery Service S3 - Postman Pat And The Clippy Claws

programme.title: Postman Pat: Special Delivery Service S3 - Postman Pat And The Sorting Machine

Using his investigating skills and following all the clues, Noddy arrives at the Naughticorn Stables where he realises that the scary noise is actually a slowed down tune on the music player.

programme.desc: When Grug wakes up without a voice, he and Ugga go on the hunt to find his voice, while Eep, Thunk, and Gran stay behind. But when the Valleyites come to Eep with questions for Grug, she takes this opportunity to be a leader by pretending to have a conversation with Grug in their cave

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S1 - The Zippleback Experience
programme.desc: After heroes Hiccup and Toothless save Barf and Belch's life, the grateful Zippleback tries to repay its life debt and abandons riders Ruff and Tuff

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S1 - Snow Way Out
programme.desc: Determined to create a key to the Dragon Eye, Ryker heads to Glacier Island to find the dangerous Snow Wraith being protected by the Dragon Riders

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - An Uphill Battle
programme.desc: The Dragon Knights make a deal for the Storm Wheel but first must obtain the other Storm Wheel from a mysterious mad scientist. Though Mastodon continues to warn the team about the dangers in using the Tianshang Weapons, they use them in a fight against Klaus and Veruca. The clash of the weapons wakes a dormant volcano!

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - The Mad Scientist
programme.desc: The Mad Scientist turns out to be an ally called Akna, who has a history with Blade's brother Alfie. And Blade learns another truth about her brother and his mission. And in the course of a skirmish with Klaus and Veruca, the weapons change hands again.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S2 - It's Purrsday!
programme.desc: It's Purrsday, the happiest cat day of the year, and all the Gabby Cats have a special purrsday surprise. Gabby and Pandy make peekaboo kitty paper chains with Baby Box, decorate a Purrsday cake with Cakey, Gabby gets a special kitty makeover with Mercat, and everyone sings a Purrsday song with DJ Catnip. For the COTD, DJ Catnip shows us how to make a DJ Catnip purr-stick!

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S2 - Doodlebook
programme.desc: Gabby unboxes a cup of crayons and a coloring book with the same doodle on every page. When she takes it into The dollhouse each of the Gabby Cats sees something different in the doodle and turns it into a uniquely magical drawing. But when CatRat gets stuck inside the book, Gabby and Pandy must go on a doodle rescue mission to save him.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S2 - Dollhouse Safari
programme.desc: It's time for a safari adventure in the dollhouse! Carlita, decked out like a safari truck, takes Gabby and Pandy on an adventure through the dollhouse as they follow clues to find the mysterious Felis Catus and discover all kinds of other dollhouse wildlife along the way! For the COTD segment, Cakey and Parrot show us how to make adorable safari snacks.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S2 - Mega Fat
programme.desc: After Mega Fat is fired from Baby Corp;he’s forced on the path of recovery towards being a Good Baby. However;Mega Fat is more interested in getting revenge on Boss Baby than finding the perfect family to adopt him.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S2 - Halloween
programme.desc: Boss Baby uses the cover of Halloween Night to sneak into Bubeezee’s Headquarters to shut it all down. Tim covers for Boss by distracting Marisol with a night of trick or treating.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S2 - Who's a Good Baby?
programme.desc: A brainwashed Boss Baby breaks free from overly sanitized Bubbeezee products. He rallies the Playgroup Babies to run the company out of business by breaking every product in town.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants and the Bad Beat of the Blah Borelock
programme.desc: With fun in short supply, Harold and George persuade Krupp to dump the campers in the middle of the forest so they can learn to rough it.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants and the Ghastly Danger of the Ghost Dentist
programme.desc: The pressure's on Harold and George to tell the scariest campfire story ever. Perhaps their tale of an ill-fated frontier dentist will do the trick.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants and the Confounding Concoction of the Crooked Combotato
programme.desc: A fierce game of plot potato takes an unexpected twist when Melvin unleashes one of his most fiendish -- and carb-loaded -- creations yet.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S1 - The Key To The Strip
programme.desc: The kids battle Shashi in Las Vegas as Shashi tries to take down evil billionaire Cleve and use Skeleton Key to create a new world order. Frostee has a plan to get Skeleton Key offline, but it only gives Tony ten seconds to take Shashi out and save the world.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S1 - Escape from L.A.
programme.desc: Tony and his crew have been working as spy racers in LA for a while now and are itching to go international. Whey they discover a mysterious man with a strange tattoo of a formula in a smuggling ring bust, Ms. Nowhere finally agrees to let them go to Rio to investigate the tattoo and the whereabouts of one of her agents who has gone dark - Layla Gray.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S1 - That Sinking Feeling
programme.desc: Ms. Nowhere drops the kids off in Brazil and leaves to go on her own important mission, but things immediately go south for Tony and his crew. When the hauler and gear gets caught in quicksand, Tony needs to learn that a good leader knows when to accept help.

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S2 - Crash Course
programme.desc: When a dangerous subterranean Cavern Crasher dragon invades the Fireworm Queen's underground nest, she approaches the Riders on Dragon's Edge for help.

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S2 - Follow The Leader
programme.desc: When Fishlegs discovers a hidden civilization of Albino Night Terrors beneath Dragon's Edge, he must craft an escape plan after they attack the Riders.

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S2 - Turn And Burn
programme.desc: Stoick, Hiccup and Snotlout search for Spitelout when he goes missing, and ultimately find him on a distant island battling a fiery Singetail dragon.

programme.title: Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia S2 - Skullcrusher
programme.desc: When Jim is imprisoned in the Darklands, Blinky tries to decipher the Amulet to save him while Claire, Toby, and NotEnrique race to recover the Killahead Bridge before it's too late

programme.title: Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia S2 - Grand Theft Otto
programme.desc: Toby gets secret transmissions through his headgear and his friends decide they need to infiltrate; meanwhile, Jim forms an unlikely alliance

programme.title: Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia S2 - Kanjigaargh
programme.desc: Blinky, Toby and Claire make a dangerous trade with the Janus Order while Gunmar sets Jim up in a battle to the death

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - The Lost City
programme.desc: With a map from the comic book, Po and Blade make the treacherous journey through the desert to the lost city, and once inside they find the guardian of the fire whip, Rukhmini. The mysterious figure, a stag named Colin, forges an uneasy alliance with Klaus and Veruca.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - The Last Guardian
programme.desc: In order to earn the fire whip, Po and Blade have to get themselves and Rukhmini out of a lost city with no exits, but Rukhimi’s not exactly who she says she is. Our villains’ alliance shatters when Colin realizes the weasels are mages with magical powers, and he leaves Klaus gravely injured.

programme.desc: With the immunity off the table, the top six bakers pair up to build a magnificent meringue tower; after receiving a postcard from home, the bakers embark on a sweet journey and deliver a dessert showcasing an international ingredient.

programme.title: Great Chocolate Showdown S4 - Lights, Camera, Chocolate!
programme.desc: The remaining five bakers must rise to the occasion as they bake chocolate bread and use it to make a dessert deli sandwich; in the elimination challenges, the bakers must create a dessert inspired by an iconic film genre.

programme.title: Great Chocolate Showdown S4 - Sweet Suspensions
programme.desc: The final four use their chocolate and confectionary skills to create a delectable trifle terrarium; with one elimination challenge before the finale, the bakers must create a three-tiered suspended cake.

programme.title: When a Man Loves a Woman - EP7
programme.desc: Man (Kwok Tsun On), Fai (Ng Chun Yu), Wah (Esther Kwan) and Shan (Fennie Yuen) grew up together and were very good friends. Man, Fai and Shan even shared an apartment. Fai was a playboy. He liked fooling around without any commitment. Man, on the other hand, was very loyal to his girlfriend - Wah._x000D__x000D_Man and Fai treated Shan as their brothers since she acted like a tom-boy. However, Shan was in love with Fai.

programme.title: Can't Buy Me Love - EP17
programme.desc: Reluctant to marry into the Tibetan royal family, the willful Princess CHIU YEUNG (Charmaine Sheh) has to find herself a husband as soon as possible. Owner of a gold store TING LOI-HEI (Kwan Kuk Ying) recommends her second and third sons, KAM DOR-LUK (Moses Chan) and KAM DOR-SHAU (Wong Ho Yin) to the Princess, hoping that the royal marriage would bring them out of financial crisis and save their family business somehow.

programme.title: Speakers Of Law - EP2
programme.desc: Kam Bing-shun (Kenneth Ma) is a top law student. However, due to a miscarriage of justice, he decides to follow the path to becoming a Legal Executive. By means of his diplomatic and tactful approach, Bing-shun gradually builds his own brand, Adviser Kam. The law firm where Adviser Kam works abruptly faces the prospect of closing down. He uses networking to defuse the situation. He is also invited by lawyers Tin Yau-ka (Lam Ha Mei) and Yu Kwok-tung (Stephen Wong) to join their team.

programme.title: Succession War - EP8
programme.desc: HESHEN (Ruco Chan) supports PRINCE YONGYAN (Shaun Tam) to accede to the throne. Following QIANLONG’s death, EMPEROR JIAQING manages to convince HESHEN’s son FENGSHEN-YINDE (Matthew Ho) and confidant FUCHANG’AN (Joel Chan) to turn their coat, seeking to sweepingly eliminate HESHEN and his cronies. But, HESHEN comes prepared.

programme.title: Food Of Love - EP24
programme.desc: Gifted cooking talent Tak (Wong Hei) wants to be a successful chef. He does not give up even when his father Kin (Leung Ka Yan) is against the idea. His uncle Kwai (Lau Kar Fai) is on his side and finally Tak is given a chance to learn in a Chinese restaurant in a hotel. There he meets his dream girl Wing (Kennix Kwok) and wins her heart. Tak’s best friend Lam (Fennie Yuen) is upset when she learns about this.
